sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकोनाशीतितमः सर्गः ।। ७९ ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekonāśītitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 79 ।।

translations.english: Then the delighted gods beheld that night-ranger, the son of Khara, struck down by the swift arrows of the son of King Dasaratha, lying scattered like a mountain shattered by a thunderbolt.
